title: two parallel CredentialStore impls must be kept in sync forever
description: stoa_auth::store::CredentialStore (crates/auth/src/store.rs) and crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs are structurally identical implementations with identical methods (from_credentials, from_content, from_file, merge_from_content, merge_from_file, check). This diff added the same from_content/merge_from_content to both. Any future method addition, bug fix, or behavior change must be applied to both — a well-intentioned contributor will update one and not the other. Reader should be refactored to use stoa_auth::CredentialStore directly.
notes: Fix requires also consolidating reader::config::UserCredential with stoa_auth::UserCredential — a broader config unification refactor. Both types are structurally identical but Rust treats them as different. Defer until config types are unified.
